'''Dervis''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]]<ref name="ISWT" /> [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. Trained in [[Temperature/Legends|cold-climate]] combat, the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was among the 1,000 SpecForce [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troopers]] who were assigned to protect [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="GG3 note" /> the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ISWT" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Dervis led an infantry detachment.<ref name="ISWT" />

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] occurred, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a ground invasion on Echo Base.<ref name="NEC" /> During the battle, Dervis's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were stationed in Echo Base's [[Hangar Bay 7]], from which they ran out to fight in defensive trenches against the Empire.<ref name="ISWT" /> The Battle of Hoth ultimately led to an Alliance defeat, with the Empire forcing them to retreat the planet.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dervis was first mentioned in the reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', written by [[James Luceno]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="ISWT" />
